messages:
alice: CI hetero smoke turned red on pool-12, tagging eng-ml. a100 shard hit OOM, l40 shard shows /lib/libcuda.so: undefined symbol: cuModuleLoad :eyes:
ci-bot: run 3187654321 failed on shards: shard-5(a100) OOM, shard-2(l40) undefined symbol. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3187654321
ben: quick q — which test? could be a flaky batch-size issue on the a100 OOM
alice: test is tests/serving/smoke/kv_cache_consistency.py::test_kv_randomized
alice: log excerpts:
```
[shard-5][OOM] Allocator could not reserve 800M for tensors
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```
```
[shard-2][ERROR] /lib/libcuda.so: undefined symbol: cuModuleLoad
```
erin: two distinct failure modes in same run implies heterogeneous images/drivers. did we start a rolling image update on pool-12?
infra-bot: rollout check: image v2024-11-04 started deploying to pool-12 yesterday 22:10 UTC. some nodes remain on v2024-11-03. pool-12 marked mixed. ops team notified.
dave: agree rerun pinned to a homogeneous node set is first step. also try with BATCH=1 and fixed seed to rule out allocator flake: BATCH=1 SEED=1337 pytest -q tests/serving/smoke/kv_cache_consistency.py::test_kv_randomized
ben: launching targeted rerun now, pinning to node-set stable-v2024-11-04 to avoid mixed images
ben: rerun id 3187654321-rrA queued (pinned to stable-v2024-11-04)
ci-bot: rerun 3187654321-rrA started. streaming logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3187654321/rrA
alice: if rrA clears, that's strong evidence OOM was caused by the mixed pool. if symbol error persists, older l40 nodes still need upgrading.
erin: if rrA still OOM on a100 with BATCH=1 we should bisect commits 3187654280..3187654321 (allocator change landed in that window). who can grab nvtx/allocator traces on failure?
dave: I can collect nvprof/nvtx traces and allocator snapshots on the rerun if it fails. will also check container limits and cgroup settings.
ci-bot: rerun 3187654321-rrA finished: shard-5 (a100) PASSED, shard-2 (l40) FAILED (same undefined symbol)
alice: ok that indicates the OOM was environmental. l40 nodes still on v2024-11-03 with older driver; symbol missing there. infra, can we cordon/upgrade those nodes? :warning:
infra-bot: cordoning nodes running v2024-11-03 in pool-12 and scheduling in-place image upgrades. ETA ~18m to complete. new jobs blocked on pool-12 until upgrade finishes. escalation sent to fw-updates.
ben: filing follow-up infra-triage issue and adding a guard in scheduler to require uniform image_label for a pool before scheduling hetero runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/489
erin: also going to propose a tiny preflight check in the smoke suite that probes /lib/libcuda.so for expected symbols before running heavy workloads. prevents confusing mixed-fleet failures.
alice: thanks everyone for the quick triage. we'll wait for image sync and re-run full smoke afterwards. :thumbsup:
